title: DCP Sine-Window Fejer/Dirichlet Kernel Cutoff Bridge
claims: tilde_gamma_sin(phi; P) = D_P(phi) + 0.5*D_P(phi + 2*pi/P) + 0.5*D_P(phi - 2*pi/P) holds identically for all phi and P >= 2.
At phi = 2*pi/P (P >= 3), D_P(2*pi/P) = 0 whereas tilde_gamma_sin(2*pi/P; P) = 1/2.
Cubic sidelobe decay is scoped to principal distance delta=dist(phi,2*pi*Z), P>=4, 4*pi/P<=delta<=pi; unrestricted absolute-frequency decay is retracted.
The P8, phi=2*pi*7.5/8 aliased-main-lobe control has sine magnitude larger than the box magnitude.
